text:
rachel: Quick proposal: shrink Optimize Toolkit MVP to get ACME pilot in 6w. Must-haves: batching advisor (recommend + simulated impact), prefix/KV cache for chat, and conservative quant recommendations (int8) with eval-gated rollback. Thoughts?

omar: +1. Keep the UI minimal: show top-2 recommendations, estimated tokens/$ saved, and a one-click apply that creates a canary (5%). No complex severity levels for alerts in MVP.

lucy: For cache: expose hit-rate and p95 latency delta. MVP target: >=25% reduction in repeated-prefix compute on our chat bench. We'll defer per-route baselines.

rachel: Proposed acceptance criteria:
- Batching advisor: sim shows >=20% token-cost reduction on synthetic high-throughput traces with p99 latency increase <=10%
- Prefix cache: >=25% repeated-prefix compute reduction in bench, hit-rate metric surfaced
- Quant recs: int8 presets + preflight eval, auto-revert to fp16 if eval drops by abs 3% (or rel 10%) during canary
- Eval alerts: webhook + single example failing prompt, default threshold = abs 3%

omar: Add safety: any "apply" is a recommendation first. Only after confirm do we start a canary and run the eval harness. Auto-revert if evaluation fails twice in 24h.

lucy: Operational note: we'll provide recommended hardware presets (A100, common AMD, cpu-int8) not per-instance tuning. Telemetry retention >30d is post-MVP (enterprise add-on).

infra-bot: created ticket RED-2988: optimize-toolkit-mvp-compact, assigned @rachel; link: https://phabricator.internal/RED-2988

tom: I'll own the canary checklist and observability hooks. Omar, can you mock the minimal UI flows? Lucy, you own cache bench and metrics. Rachel, please draft the one-pager + customer-facing onboarding for ACME.

rachel: I'll post one-pager tonight and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow. If anyone sees a hard blocker for the 6w target call it out here by EOD.

omar: Will try UI mocks in 3d.

lucy: Bench notes coming tomorrow.

tom: I'll scope the eval harness and automation, posting rough cost/latency estimates by EOD.

rachel: Thanks all. Final: cut per-route thresholds, per-GPU microprofiles, and long-term alert retention to post-MVP.
